verdicts.proof: Old 70a94933 reservation_edit_screen.dart:1318 and current :1673 show the pickup card only if !_isActive && tab not move/swap. v2: reservation_edit_screen.dart:1564-1565 passes pickupPlace/pickupTime = null when _isActive or datesOrSwap; res_edit_view_v2.dart:147 hides the whole pickup group when both are null. The only route to the edit screen is /reservations/:id/edit (router.dart:427), and v1 and v2 share the same State, so no other v2 path changes the pickup place/time. Server: trg_guard_booking_delivery active_pickup_locked (STATE_4:73).

pickupBlocked/returnBlocked are computed once in build (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1310-1320, same as 70a94933:1097-1107) and passed to the same AddressPickerWidget (:1467, :1484). address_picker.dart:214-219 swaps the delivery radio for BookingLockedOptionTile, and the address row at :230 is gated by !deliveryBlocked in both looks. In v2, BookingLockedOptionTile renders BookingLockedOptionV2View (booking_form_locked_option.dart:40; handover_v2.dart:184-244), which has a lock icon, the label, the short reason and the same tap-to-expand info. Server: I could not find trg_check_self_service_delivery in STATE_4 or in supabase/migrations (STATE_5:102 describes it only as proposed). trg_guard_booking_delivery covers the fees only.

The post-frame reset to 'store' with fee 0 (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1321-1336, same as 70a94933:1108-1123) runs in build before the MgV2.on branch at :1546, so it fires in both looks. It is silent in both looks, so v2 shows it no less clearly than the old look.

Old 70a94933:640-642: _save refuses with the toast 'clickEnterAddress' when calc.deliveryAddressMissing is true. Current reservation_edit_screen.dart:797-801 has the same check, and the condition is in reservation_edit_price_calc.dart:224-228. In v2 the only save path is the dock MgCta (res_edit_view_v2.dart:190-197). Its onSave is the shared saveAction (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1528-1530 -> _save), so the refusal runs. The v2 address row with no address reads 'v2BkEnterAddress' with a link-coloured border and a chevron (res_edit_address_v2.dart:50, :62-68), which is at least as visible as the old grey 'Klikněte pro zadání adresy'. The save button stays enabled in both looks. Server: trg_guard_booking_delivery delivery_fee_guard (STATE_4:73).

This rule is not in 4.1.3: the 70a94933 address_picker.dart:73-105 has no initialAddress and no unchanged check. It was added on this branch in address_picker.dart:153-177 (_onSaved) and is shared by both looks. The v2 row calls the same _openAddressSheet/_onSaved through AddressRowData.onTap (:232-239). Server: trg_guard_booking_delivery (STATE_4:73) also blocks a 're-entered address' fee trick.

Old 70a94933:367-380 _deliveryLeadError is used in _saveMove (:569-573) and in _save (:632-636). Current: reservation_edit_screen.dart:422-435, used at :646-651 (_saveMove) and :791-795 (_save). The v2 dock onSave is the same saveAction (:1528-1530: _saveMove on the move tab, otherwise _save; passed at :1586). The swap tab has no dock (saveLabel null). There is no other v2 save path. In both looks the customer only sees the same toast. Server: I found no 6 h lead-time rule in STATE_3/4, so server = unknown.

Old 70a94933:1147-1150 (legacyPickup) and :1334-1338 (the line). In v2, pickupLegacyLine = legacyPickup && effPickup != 'delivery' (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1566), drawn by res_edit_notes_v2.dart:89-92 above the same picker. The picker gets value '09:00' only as a suggestion (:1474), and _pickupTouched is set only in onChanged, which the v2 EditTimePickerV2/TimeFieldV2 calls only when the customer taps a chip (time_sheet_v2.dart:74-76).

Old 70a94933:1138-1139 (pickupAtSelfService) and :1348-1352 (the 🌗 ssPickupHint line). In v2, pickupSelfServiceHint = pickupAtSelfService (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1567), drawn at res_edit_notes_v2.dart:94-107 with a ½ badge and the same ssPickupHint text, inside the pickup group that exists under the same condition (:1565). Server: _kiosk_release_at / trg_booking_kiosk_release_sync (STATE_4:74).

Old: reservation_edit_widgets.dart (70a94933) offers hours 00-23 and minutes 00/15/30/45 in two dropdowns. In v2, EditTimePicker branches at reservation_edit_widgets.dart:118-124 to EditTimePickerV2 (res_edit_sections_v2.dart:40-67). That widget uses TimeFieldV2 with minutes [0,15,30,45], and the sheet loops h 0..23 (time_sheet_v2.dart:50-79). It emits only HH:MM values from that set. The same applies to the return time picker (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1492-1493).

Old 70a94933:1356: the return card shows when tab is not move/swap, also for an active rental. In v2, returnPlace and returnTime are set only when !datesOrSwap (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1568-1569; datesOrSwap at :1547). res_edit_view_v2.dart:162 shows the group only if one of them is not null. The active state does not hide it, the same as in the old look.

Old 70a94933:1140-1141 (hideReturnTime), :1169-1173 (returnFix) and :1370 (picker hidden). In v2, returnTime = null when hideReturnTime (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1569). The returnFix post-frame write runs in the shared build before the v2 branch (:1382-1400). Neither look explains it. Server: unknown.

returnBlocked (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1318-1320, same as 70a94933:1105-1107) is passed to the return AddressPickerWidget (:1484). The tile is locked at address_picker.dart:214-219, and in v2 BookingLockedOptionTile renders BookingLockedOptionV2View (booking_form_locked_option.dart:40). The address row is gated at :230. Server: I could not find a self-service delivery trigger in STATE_4 or migrations, so server = unknown.

address_picker.dart:131-146 didUpdateWidget clears the fee and the address when the method leaves 'delivery'. This is shared code (the old 70a94933:52-71 did the same; the branch now refills from initialAddress, which is still 'unchanged'). _save writes return_address/lat/lng = null when the method switches away from delivery (reservation_edit_screen.dart:860-863), the same for both looks. Server: trg_guard_booking_delivery (a) nulls the address (STATE_4:73).

Old 70a94933:1425-1432 shows an amber box with stornoConditions + stornoRules when tab == 'shorten', plus the dynamic warning when diffDays < 0. In v2, res_edit_view_v2.dart:172-175 shows ResEditNoteV2(warn) with the same text (amber with an info icon, res_edit_notes_v2.dart:22-35), plus ResStornoWarningV2 as an MgStateBanner title. stornoPct is passed only when shorten && diffDays < 0 (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1572-1574).
